economic_gate.promotion: measured complete-request throughput and sustainable cost must clear the matched market gate and be at least 10 percent below the matched stock H100 control; component-only evidence cannot claim endpoint promotion

ranked_combinations.combination: H100 SXM + exact online FP8 linear/KV consumers + fused paged hybrid local/global attention
ranked_combinations.why: H100 is 13.8 percent below H200 planning cost, has broad exact vLLM support, 80 GiB HBM2e and 3.35 TB/s, while the exact 5376/21504 tiles are tensor-core friendly. A fused attention path targets the remaining compulsory KV/paging and scheduler boundary rather than repeating the live L40S rows.
ranked_combinations.limiter_hypothesis: decode is dominated by repeated FP8 weight/HBM streams plus paged local/global KV reads and launch overhead; separate five-local/one-global dispatch wastes work at small M
ranked_combinations.uncertainty: high: no H100 workload measurement and fused kernel availability must be pinned
ranked_combinations.expected_sustainable_effect: 10-25 percent versus matched stock H100 FP8 at the workload knee; enough only if complete-request rps is at least 1.8249 planning-base and the 10-percent matched-control gate passes

ranked_combinations.combination: MI355X + ROCm/AITER exact Gemma BF16 or MXFP8 fused attention
ranked_combinations.why: 8 TB/s HBM3e and 256 MiB cache are attractive for long prompt/KV traffic and the planning rate is below H200, but the current screen has no immutable ROCm image digest or self-service venue. Official model support is not execution evidence.
ranked_combinations.falsifier: content-addressed image or venue probe fails before a matched control

ranked_combinations.combination: B200 SXM + FP4/FP6 fused linear and paged attention
ranked_combinations.why: 8 TB/s HBM3e, 126 MiB L2 and native FP4 are mechanically interesting, but the 5.15 USD/GPU-hour planning rate implies 3.3552 requests/s at the same market floor and the runtime is rapidly maturing; no exact Gemma consumer or measured shape result is bound.
ranked_combinations.falsifier: exact runtime cannot bind FP4/FP6 producer, consumer, and quality-preserving checkpoint

first_experiment.venue: the shared Nebius H100 lifecycle/controller; activation requires a later nonzero authorization and an immutable vLLM image/source packet
first_experiment.stock_comparator: same image and exact shapes using stock vLLM BF16 linear plus stock paged hybrid attention and BF16 KV
first_experiment.intervention: actual pinned vLLM online-FP8 linear consumer and FP8-per-token-head KV writer, followed by one fused paged hybrid attention kernel that consumes local 16x256 and global 4x512 pages in one scheduler-visible decode step

measurement.oracle: finite outputs plus BF16 reference error on every timed component; complete-request raw outputs remain required for endpoint promotion

first_experiment.hypothesis: fusing hybrid attention removes enough page-table, launch, and KV movement overhead to leave the H100 FP8 path below the planning market gate; a stock-vs-fused matched component result is the first falsifier

falsification.component: reject if fused attention is not at least 10 percent faster than matched stock attention at every engine-valid selected point or numerical oracle fails
falsification.whole_request: reject if complete-request throughput is below 1.8249 requests/s at planning factors, or sustainable cost is not at least 10 percent below matched stock H100 control
falsification.mechanism: reject if HBM/L2 and launch telemetry do not show the predicted reduction, even if elapsed time improves

budget.quality: component oracle in first arm; exact checkpoint quality only after a complete-request pass

first_experiment.launcher_dependency: reuse the shared retained-owner/controller and exact-image audit from the L40S online-FP8 lane; do not create a project-local lifecycle owner. Before provider create, bind the H100 image digest, fused-kernel source hash, actual consumer symbols, and output-consuming audit.

evidence.claim: H200 BF16 linears/head close c1/c4/c8; c32 remains only a narrow stock point
L40S FP8 attention/KV residual is 0.164631539 s/request and does not itself close the candidate
live L40S online FP8/W4 lane is pending and must not be duplicated
MI355X lacks immutable runtime and executable venue in scope
